title: Base AtomicReadFile variant 3 revised
purpose: Add a structurally distinct file-service seed using a confirmed AtomicReadFile request with stream-style parameters, a negative offset, and a bounded requested octet count.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP server should parse the frame as a confirmed AtomicReadFile request and then return file data or an error depending on file object state, permissions, and support for the requested access parameters.
constraints_preserved: BVLC total length 0x001a matches the full encoded message length
Common BACnet/IP BVLC plus NPDU plus APDU layering is preserved
File object identifier appears before access parameters
Signed offset and unsigned count are each encoded with explicit value bytes
Hex is lowercase and has an even number of characters
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability issue knowledge is available. This is a conservative model-prior file-service coverage seed, not a claim of verified protocol validity.
